title: Morphology-Aware Sample Assignment: Overcoming IoU Insensitivity for Surface Defect Detection
abstract: arXiv:2606.13723v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Intersection-over-Union (IoU), as a pivotal metric for evaluating the spatial alignment between candidate proposals and ground-truth annotations, directly determines the quality of positive sample sets and the training efficacy of visual detection models. Through theoretical modeling and analysis, we uncover a non-sensitive region on the IoU response curve, within which samples yield nearly identical IoU scores despite distinct geometric overlaps. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a set of morphological similarity metrics covering area, shape, and aspect ratio, to refine the positive sample assignment process, thereby ensuring more discriminative and reliable matching. A supplementary matching score is derived via mean-based aggregation of these multidimensional similarities, compensating for the intrinsic limitation of IoU in representing structural correspondence. Theoretically, incorporating morphological similarity

translated_title: 形态感知样本分配：克服表面缺陷检测中的IoU不敏感性
translated_abstract: 交并比（IoU）作为评估候选提议框与真实标注之间空间对齐程度的关键指标，直接决定了正样本集合的质量以及视觉检测模型的训练效果。通过理论建模与分析，我们发现了IoU响应曲线上的一个非敏感区域，在该区域内，尽管样本具有不同的几何重叠程度，却会产生几乎相同的IoU分数。为克服这一局限性，我们引入了一组覆盖面积、形状和长宽比的形态相似性度量，以优化正样本分配过程，从而确保更具判别性和可靠性的匹配。通过对这些多维相似性进行基于均值的聚合，我们推导出一个补充匹配分数，以弥补IoU在表征结构对应关系方面的内在局限。从理论上讲，引入形态相似性……
tldr: 该论文通过理论分析发现IoU响应曲线存在非敏感区域，并提出融合面积、形状和长宽比的多维形态相似性度量来改进正样本分配，从而提升表面缺陷检测的精度与可靠性。
en_tdlr: The paper uncovers a non-sensitive region in the IoU response curve and proposes morphology-aware similarity metrics covering area, shape, and aspect ratio to refine positive sample assignment, enhancing surface defect detection performance.
